frame: supergalactic cartesian, Sun at the origin
model: SCHEMATIC. The Milky Way is seen from inside, so its arm pattern is not directly observed.
references: R0 = 8.178 kpc, GRAVITY Collaboration 2019, A&A 625, L10
Arm naming follows Reid et al. 2019, ApJ 885, 131; the geometry here is an idealised four-arm logarithmic spiral, not their fitted model.
